shared_elements: upright slab (stele) with figural scene carved in relief on one face
standing human figure(s) in ceremonial pose
script signs or glyph blocks integrated with the figural scene
figures holding staff-like or ritual objects
blank or plain lower register/base zone
justification: Both are upright commemorative slabs whose principal face shows standing ceremonial human figures wearing tall elaborate headdresses, holding staff-like objects, accompanied by blocks of script placed within the figural field, with a plain zone below. The manner of depiction differs sharply: A uses flat, strictly profile figures with clean incised outline, wide empty ground and a framed arched upper register with winged/solar motif, while B is a dense, deeply modelled, largely frontal figure whose costume ornament fills nearly the whole surface with no empty ground.
